LanguageData.PV_Profile_FogOfWar_Desc: Standard Project Vigilance experience. Unexplored hexes shrouded in darkness; dynamic charting through caravans, outposts, and radar networks.
LanguageData.PV_Profile_PlanetarySurveillance_Desc: World geography and biomes known from orbital scans. Dynamic incursions and outposts concealed outside sensor range.
LanguageData.PV_Profile_HardcoreVigilance_Desc: Strict sensory limits: planetary shroud, tightened lookout horizons, terrain masking, and nocturnal vigilance penalties.
LanguageData.PV_Profile_Omniscient_Desc: Vanilla RimWorld global visibility: all settlements, terrain, and landmarks revealed from day one.
LanguageData.PV_Profile_Custom_Desc: Fine-tuned custom ruleset configured through individual simulation toggles.
